players.product: optical fiber / cable and external laser sources (ELS) for co-packaged optics

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): in the latest forecast revision the full-year Optical Solutions forecast was raised by JPY 25.0 billion in net sales and JPY 16.0 billion in operating profit versus the previous forecast, and Digital Infrastructure Components operating profit by JPY 12.0 billion; pricing factors are estimated to account for nearly half of the full-year Optical Solutions profit improvement
quarterly_data.figure: Optical Solutions full-year forecast +JPY 25.0 billion net sales, +JPY 16.0 billion operating profit; Digital Infrastructure Components +JPY 12.0 billion operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): within the Optical Solutions revision, data-center sales, mix and pricing add approximately JPY 3.5 billion of operating profit in the first half and approximately JPY 5.5 billion in the second half (with Rollable Ribbon Cable sales increasing); specialty fiber, including products for submarine transmission lines, adds approximately JPY 4.5 billion for the full year, mainly on volume; MT ferrules add approximately JPY 2.5 billion, mainly from increased production capacity; Q1 Optical Solutions operating profit improved from a loss of JPY 0.7 billion to a profit of JPY 9.2 billion year on year
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 Optical Solutions operating profit JPY 9.2 billion (loss of JPY 0.7 billion a year earlier); specialty fiber approximately +JPY 4.5 billion; MT ferrules approximately +JPY 2.5 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): approximately JPY 5.5 billion of the Digital Infrastructure Components profit revision relates to laser chip products including DFB laser chips and SOA, driven mainly by increased production capacity rather than price; copper foil was raised approximately JPY 2.5 billion on a mix shift toward high-performance copper foil driven by AI data center demand; the revision does not newly include water-cooling products; versus Q1 a year earlier, cooling products were a negative of approximately JPY 2.0 billion (air-cooling pull-forward last year) while laser products added approximately JPY 2.0 billion and copper foil approximately JPY 1.5 billion
quarterly_data.figure: laser chip products approximately +JPY 5.5 billion; copper foil approximately +JPY 2.5 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): optical fiber production is operating close to its maximum capacity relative to demand; the bottleneck is optical fiber itself, and the company converts fiber into high-value-added cables rather than selling fiber externally; Rollable Ribbon Cable capacity is available through the fiscal year with room to increase toward Q4, and until expansion the company will respond through production mix changes and pricing revisions

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): the optical fiber and cable capacity investment covers preform through fiber drawing and is planned to support a doubling of Rollable Ribbon Cable production capacity, which the company aims to reach from the second half of FY2028 onward, when the additional fiber capacity is planned to come on stream; fiber capacity will be expanded at one or more of the four previously announced locations, and Rollable Ribbon Cable is produced and will be expanded in Japan, Brazil and the United States; the company disclosed the investment because it concluded there is a high degree of certainty that customers will purchase a certain volume over the long term, but declined to give purchase-commitment terms
quarterly_data.figure: Rollable Ribbon Cable capacity to double from the second half of FY2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): demand for DFB laser chips remains extremely strong; DFB laser chip capacity had expanded to approximately five times the FY2023 level by the end of the first half of FY2025 and the company is adding a further 1.5 times versus FY2025 in FY2026, with the mix shifted toward higher-margin products such as SOA; Q1 DFB laser chip shipments were approximately 1.3 times those of the fourth quarter of the previous fiscal year; MT ferrule capacity had likewise reached approximately five times the FY2023 level, with volumes to rise through yield improvements and some equipment additions
quarterly_data.figure: DFB laser chip capacity approximately five times FY2023, a further 1.5 times in FY2026; Q1 shipments approximately 1.3 times the previous fiscal year's fourth quarter

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): production of water-cooling modules began in June and the ramp-up is progressing smoothly; a modest profit contribution is expected in the second quarter, increasing significantly from the third through the fourth quarter; the assumption of approximately JPY 18.0 billion in profit growth from cooling products in the second half is unchanged, and the company has not heard of any change in customer demand
quarterly_data.figure: approximately JPY 18.0 billion second-half profit growth from cooling products

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): the forecast includes only price revisions visible as of Q1, reflecting the pass-through of higher optical fiber prices to optical cable pricing including Rollable Ribbon Cable; price negotiations continue toward Q4 with room for additional increases not yet in the forecast

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): market demand remains extremely strong and many industry participants are evaluating expansions; while more supply from China and elsewhere is anticipated, significant barriers to entry remain in the U.S. market, making a rapid influx unlikely; on reported U.S. import restrictions on Chinese-made transceivers and optical components, Chinese manufacturers are believed to hold a significant share of the data center module market, so an immediate restriction could make alternative suppliers hard to secure and possibly delay data center deployment; the company is gathering information and not rushing into action

quarterly_data.quarter: Furukawa Electric results briefing Q&A: FY2026Q1 Financial Results Q&A Summary (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Aoshima (results briefing Q&A): the company expects the submarine network market to keep growing over the next three to five years, and specialty fiber capacity expansions under way in FY2026 should contribute on a full-year basis from FY2027; certification has been obtained for certain lower-fiber-count pre-terminated cable products, while certification of higher-fiber-count products is ongoing and not included in the forecast
